id, trade_date, exchange, stock_code, stock_name, source, financing_balance, financing_buy_amount, financing_repay_amount, securities_lending_balance, securities_lending_balance_amount, securities_lending_sell_volume, securities_lending_repay_volume, coalesce(margin_balance, coalesce(financing_balance, 0) + coalesce(securities_lending_balance_amount, 0)) as margin_balance, extra, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at

mapper.select:
select max(trade_date) from margin_market_summary where deleted_at is null
and trade_date <= #{endDate}
select from margin_market_summary where deleted_at is null and trade_date = #{tradeDate} order by exchange asc, source asc
select from margin_account_stats where deleted_at is null and trade_date = #{tradeDate} order by updated_at desc nulls last limit 1
select from margin_market_summary where deleted_at is null and trade_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} order by trade_date asc, exchange asc, source asc

with ranked_stocks as ( select s.*, row_number() over ( partition by s.stock_code order by case when s.source = 'eastmoney.datacenter.margin' then 0 when s.source like 'exchange.%' then 1 when s.source like 'akshare.%' then 2 else 3 end, s.updated_at desc nulls last, s.id desc ) as stock_rank from margin_stock_detail s where s.deleted_at is null and s.trade_date = #{tradeDate}
and s.exchange = #{exchange}
) select from ranked_stocks s where s.stock_rank = 1
and exists ( select 1 from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot c where c.deleted_at is null and c.industry_code = #{industryCode} and c.stock_code = s.stock_code and c.snapshot_date = coalesce( ( select max(c1.snapshot_date) from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot c1 where c1.deleted_at is null and c1.snapshot_date <= #{tradeDate} ), ( select max(c2.snapshot_date) from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot c2 where c2.deleted_at is null ) ) )
order by
s.stock_code
s.stock_name
s.exchange
s.financing_balance
s.financing_buy_amount
s.financing_repay_amount
s.securities_lending_balance
s.securities_lending_balance_amount
coalesce(s.margin_balance, coalesce(s.financing_balance, 0) + coalesce(s.securities_lending_balance_amount, 0))
asc nulls last desc nulls last
, s.stock_code asc offset #{offset} limit #{limit}

select from margin_stock_detail where deleted_at is null and stock_code = #{stockCode} and id in ( select id from ( select id, row_number() over ( partition by trade_date order by case when source = 'eastmoney.datacenter.margin' then 0 when source like 'exchange.%' then 1 when source like 'akshare.%' then 2 else 3 end, updated_at desc nulls last, id desc ) as history_rank from margin_stock_detail where deleted_at is null and stock_code = #{stockCode} ) ranked where history_rank = 1 ) order by trade_date desc, updated_at desc limit #{limit}
mapper.sql: with snapshot_pick as ( select coalesce( ( select max(snapshot_date) from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot where deleted_at is null and snapshot_date <= #{tradeDate} ), ( select max(snapshot_date) from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot where deleted_at is null ) ) as snapshot_date ), constituents as ( select distinct c.snapshot_date, c.industry_code, c.stock_code from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot c join snapshot_pick sp on sp.snapshot_date = c.snapshot_date where c.deleted_at is null ), latest_stocks as ( select stock_code, financing_balance, financing_buy_amount, financing_repay_amount, securities_lending_balance, securities_lending_balance_amount, securities_lending_sell_volume, securities_lending_repay_volume, margin_balance from ( select s.*, row_number() over ( partition by s.stock_code order by case when s.source = 'eastmoney.datacenter.margin' then 0 when s.source like 'exchange.%' then 1 when s.source like 'akshare.%' then 2 else 3 end, s.updated_at desc nulls last, s.id desc ) as stock_rank from margin_stock_detail s where s.deleted_at is null and s.trade_date = #{tradeDate} ) ranked where stock_rank = 1 ), industry_mapping as ( select tdx_code6, tdx_name, ths_code, ths_name from ( select m.*, row_number() over ( partition by m.ths_code order by m.is_primary desc, m.priority asc, m.confidence desc ) as rn from tdx_ths_industry_mapping m where m.deleted_at is null ) ranked where rn = 1 ), ths_industry_names as ( select item ->> 'sectorCode' as ths_code, item ->> 'name' as ths_name from mkt_heatmap_snapshot h join snapshot_pick sp on h.snapshot_date = coalesce( ( select max(h1.snapshot_date) from mkt_heatmap_snapshot h1 where h1.deleted_at is null and h1.kind = 'industries' and h1.snapshot_date <= sp.snapshot_date ), ( select max(h2.snapshot_date) from mkt_heatmap_snapshot h2 where h2.deleted_at is null and h2.kind = 'industries' ) ) cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(h.payload -> 'items', '[]'::jsonb)) item where h.deleted_at is null and h.kind = 'industries' and item ->> 'sectorCode' is not null ), industry_agg as ( select #{tradeDate}::date as trade_date, c.snapshot_date as constituent_snapshot_date, c.industry_code, coalesce(max(im.ths_name), max(tn.ths_name), c.industry_code) as industry_name, max(im.tdx_code6) as tdx_code, max(im.tdx_name) as tdx_name, count(distinct c.stock_code)::int as constituent_count, count(distinct s.stock_code)::int as matched_stock_count, coalesce(sum(s.financing_balance), 0) as financing_balance, coalesce(sum(s.financing_buy_amount), 0) as financing_buy_amount, coalesce(sum(s.financing_repay_amount), 0) as financing_repay_amount, coalesce(sum(s.securities_lending_balance), 0) as securities_lending_balance, coalesce(sum(s.securities_lending_balance_amount), 0) as securities_lending_balance_amount, coalesce(sum(s.securities_lending_sell_volume), 0) as securities_lending_sell_volume, coalesce(sum(s.securities_lending_repay_volume), 0) as securities_lending_repay_volume, coalesce(sum(coalesce(s.margin_balance, coalesce(s.financing_balance, 0) + coalesce(s.securities_lending_balance_amount, 0))), 0) as margin_balance, null::numeric as turnover_amount from constituents c left join industry_mapping im on im.ths_code = c.industry_code left join ths_industry_names tn on tn.ths_code = c.industry_code left join latest_stocks s on s.stock_code = c.stock_code group by c.snapshot_date, c.industry_code )
mapper.select:
select trade_date, constituent_snapshot_date, industry_code, industry_name, tdx_code, tdx_name, constituent_count, matched_stock_count, financing_balance, financing_buy_amount, financing_repay_amount, securities_lending_balance, securities_lending_balance_amount, securities_lending_sell_volume, securities_lending_repay_volume, margin_balance, turnover_amount from industry_agg order by
industry_code
industry_name
tdx_code
tdx_name
constituent_count
matched_stock_count
financing_balance
financing_buy_amount
financing_repay_amount
securities_lending_balance
securities_lending_balance_amount
margin_balance
asc nulls last desc nulls last
, industry_code asc offset #{offset} limit #{limit}

with snapshot_pick as ( select coalesce( ( select max(snapshot_date) from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot where deleted_at is null and snapshot_date <= #{tradeDate} ), ( select max(snapshot_date) from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot where deleted_at is null ) ) as snapshot_date ) select distinct c.industry_code, c.stock_code from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot c join snapshot_pick sp on sp.snapshot_date = c.snapshot_date where c.deleted_at is null and c.industry_code in
#{industryCode}

with params as ( select #{tradeDate}::date as end_date ), snapshot_pick as ( select coalesce( ( select max(snapshot_date) from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot where deleted_at is null and industry_code = #{industryCode} and snapshot_date <= (select end_date from params) ), ( select max(snapshot_date) from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot where deleted_at is null and industry_code = #{industryCode} ) ) as snapshot_date ), constituents as ( select distinct c.stock_code from ths_industry_constituent_snapshot c join snapshot_pick sp on sp.snapshot_date = c.snapshot_date where c.deleted_at is null and c.industry_code = #{industryCode} ), dates as ( select distinct s.trade_date from margin_stock_detail s join constituents c on c.stock_code = s.stock_code where s.deleted_at is null and s.trade_date <= (select end_date from params) order by s.trade_date desc limit #{limit} ), ranked_stocks as ( select s.*, row_number() over ( partition by s.trade_date, s.stock_code order by case when s.source = 'eastmoney.datacenter.margin' then 0 when s.source like 'exchange.%' then 1 when s.source like 'akshare.%' then 2 else 3 end, s.updated_at desc nulls last, s.id desc ) as stock_rank from margin_stock_detail s join constituents c on c.stock_code = s.stock_code join dates d on d.trade_date = s.trade_date where s.deleted_at is null ), industry_history as ( select s.trade_date, (select snapshot_date from snapshot_pick) as constituent_snapshot_date, #{industryCode} as industry_code, (select count(*)::int from constituents) as constituent_count, count(distinct s.stock_code)::int as matched_stock_count, coalesce(sum(s.financing_balance), 0) as financing_balance, coalesce(sum(s.financing_buy_amount), 0) as financing_buy_amount, coalesce(sum(s.financing_repay_amount), 0) as financing_repay_amount, coalesce(sum(s.securities_lending_balance), 0) as securities_lending_balance, coalesce(sum(s.securities_lending_balance_amount), 0) as securities_lending_balance_amount, coalesce(sum(s.securities_lending_sell_volume), 0) as securities_lending_sell_volume, coalesce(sum(s.securities_lending_repay_volume), 0) as securities_lending_repay_volume, coalesce(sum(coalesce(s.margin_balance, coalesce(s.financing_balance, 0) + coalesce(s.securities_lending_balance_amount, 0))), 0) as margin_balance, null::numeric as turnover_amount from ranked_stocks s where s.stock_rank = 1 group by s.trade_date ) select trade_date, constituent_snapshot_date, industry_code, constituent_count, matched_stock_count, financing_balance, financing_buy_amount, financing_repay_amount, securities_lending_balance, securities_lending_balance_amount, securities_lending_sell_volume, securities_lending_repay_volume, margin_balance, turnover_amount from industry_history order by trade_date asc
